issuing_body: Minnesota Judicial Branch (Minnesota Court Records Online / MCRO)
title: Register of Actions, Feeding Our Future vs. Minnesota Department of Education, Case No. 62-CV-20-5492 (Ramsey County District Court)
court: Ramsey County District Court, Ramsey Civil
notes: MCRO's own terms state it is provided as a service and is 'not the official court case record'; the Judicial Branch does not certify MCRO search results. Treat the register as a highly reliable but not certified docket index. The initial automated-browser attempt to download individual PDFs failed because the download control is a session-bound CSRF-protected form POST, not a static URL. A later pass demonstrated a working method: replicate the per-document form as an authenticated fetch POST from within the active MCRO browser session. That method successfully retrieved multiple underlying filings and orders, which are represented by separate source records. The register itself remains evidence of docket metadata, not the contents of each filing.
supports: Case 62-CV-20-5492, Feeding Our Future vs. Minnesota Department of Education, was filed 2020-11-20 in Ramsey County District Court (Civil Other/Misc.). Plaintiff: Feeding Our Future (attorney Llonyddwch Rhyddid Marriott Watkins). Defendant: Minnesota Department of Education (attorneys Martha J. Casserly, Keith M. Ellison, Kristine Kay Nogosek, Alexander Robertson Sloan).

Judicial assignment history: Judge John H. Guthmann was assigned 2020-11-20 and presided through at least the 2021-07-27 hearing; the case was reassigned to Judge Patrick C. Diamond effective 2021-08-12 (Notice of Case Reassignment, Index #124), and Diamond presided from the September 2021 discovery conference through the case's 2022-02-02 dismissal. Diamond is the 'Judicial Officer' currently shown on the case's summary record, which explains why some legal-database summaries list Diamond rather than Guthmann despite Guthmann having presided over the 2021 stop-pay litigation.
A Temporary Restraining Order Hearing was held 2021-04-21 at 2:00 PM before Judge Guthmann (remote/Zoom), with a 'Briefs' filing that same day (Index #28, 11 pages).
Feeding Our Future filed a 'Motion-Contempt' on 2021-04-23 (Index #32, 11 pages), two days after the April 21 hearing and one week before MDE removed the stop-pay.

A second Temporary Restraining Order Hearing was held 2021-04-30 at 3:00 PM before Judge Guthmann (remote/Zoom), the same calendar day MDE voluntarily removed its stop-pay per OLA's timeline. The docket records an 'Order for Submissions-Under Advisement' that same day (Index #50) and several same-day filings: two 25-page 'Other Document' entries, two 1-page attorney affidavits, a 5-page 'Briefs' filing (Index #43), and a 3-page 'Affidavit-Other' (Index #42).

Judge Guthmann issued an 'Order-Other' on 2021-06-24 (Index #95, 8 pages) and a further 'Order-Other' on 2021-07-15 (Index #120, 1 page); a Scheduling Order and mediation referral followed 2021-07-02.
The case was voluntarily dismissed without prejudice on 2022-02-02 before Judge Diamond, with judgment and notice of entry of judgment entered the same day.

MCRO's financial-information section shows the plaintiff (Feeding Our Future) was assessed $1,150.00 in court fines/fees, fully paid, with a $0.00 balance as of the 2026-08-29 retrieval date. This is ordinary court-fee accounting and is separate from the contempt sanction and stipulated attorneys' fees established by the June 24 order.
does_not_support: The substantive text of a filing merely because its docket entry appears here. Underlying document text must be cited to the separately retrieved filing/order/transcript source record.

Any causal finding that the 2021-04-30 hearing itself produced or required MDE's decision to remove the stop-pay that same day; later-retrieved filings and the hearing transcript resolve that chronology more directly.

The sanction amount by itself; the $35,750 contempt sanction plus $11,750 stipulated attorneys' fees ($47,500 total) is established by the separately retrieved June 24 order source, not by this register's financial-information section.
